items.title: David Weiss interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 3, 2022

ctx.x: The more avante garde guys, have you seen, they’re doing tributes to — you know Lester Bowie does Louis Armstrong. They come, I mean they skipped bebop. They took all the wonderful things about swing and that expressiveness and all the stuff those guys did, and they kind of continue on from there. That’s where they found their more emotional truth or their melodic sense or whatever it is they’re trying to do. I mean that’s one school of avante garde and it is the ones that are like the amazing composers, the ones…
